result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the top-right profile/avatar control appears broken: it renders as an empty gray circle with a stray red notification dot floating inside it instead of an avatar icon with a properly anchored badge. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between the two restaurant cards. Horizontal carousel clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header (next to the 'DELIVER TO' address) is an empty light-gray circle with no avatar image, user icon, or initials. It looks like a failed image load or an unrendered placeholder, leaving the control unlabeled and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Render the user's avatar image, or fall back to a default person icon/initials when no image is available. Ensure the placeholder state still shows a recognizable glyph and has an accessible label (e.g., 'Account').

issues.description: The red notification dot on the empty avatar circle sits loosely inside the circle near its upper-right interior rather than being anchored to the circle's edge, making it look detached/misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Position the badge absolutely relative to the avatar container so it overlaps the top-right edge of the circle (partially outside), with a consistent offset and a white border ring for separation.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons are inconsistent across cards: on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card the heart is a bare white outline over the image, while on the pizza card below it sits on a dark translucent circular backdrop. The bare version has weaker contrast against light image areas.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background (or a consistent scrim/shadow) to all heart buttons so they remain legible over any image and look uniform.
